text: Every smile below started with a conversation, a full examination, and a plan built around that specific patient. No shortcuts. No assumptions.
From the moment you walk in, Arvada Dental feels different. Calm, modern, and built with patients in mind - because your experience starts before you sit in the chair.
This is a real Arvada Dental patient. He had not seen a dentist in nine years, expected a lecture, and was braced for bad news. Drag the slider to see where he is now.
Nine years since his last checkup
Putting it off because he expected judgment
A cracked filling he had learned to chew around
No idea what his insurance actually covered
Bounced between three offices for one problem
Back on a six-month schedule, no drama
Told exactly what things cost, upfront
Treated by the same dentist every visit
Not one word about the nine years
You move, your old dentist retires, or one bad experience puts you off. A year becomes five. Then finding a dentist starts to feel like something you need to prepare for.
“Nobody made me feel bad about it.”
A full exam, X-rays, and an honest conversation about where you actually stand. No lectures, no scare tactics, and no treatment plan you did not ask for.
“For once I knew what it would cost.”
If you need work, you get it in writing what it is, why it matters, what it costs, and what can safely wait. You choose the order.
“Now it's just twice a year and done.”
Once you are caught up, staying there is easy. Same practice, same dentist, same team who know your history and a reminder when you are due.

faq.q: Which insurance plans do you accept?
faq.a: We accept a wide range of insurance plans. During your first visit, all your clinical and financial questions will be answered.

faq.q: I don’t have Insurance, what do I do?
faq.a: No insurance? No problem. We have offers and payment plan options that will make your treatment very affordable.

faq.q: What is the new patient experience like?
faq.a: New patients will first do a comprehensive full-mouth examination. Then, the doctor will provide the treatment options.‍

We offer consultations that may be covered by insurance or provided at a reduced cost, depending on your coverage. We believe in the quality of our practice and are committed to providing exceptional service during these consultations.

faq.q: Do you have payment plan options?
faq.a: Yes, absolutely! We have payment solutions for all budgets. We make high quality dental care affordable.

faq.q: How many visits do I need to make?
faq.a: The number of visits depend on your case.‍

faq.q: How long will my treatment take?
faq.a: We do the full spectrum of dentistry. All treatments are done in-house.
